Espionage Combat Styles

Choose between evasive repositioning and delayed traps in the Espionage combat trees.

Espionage - Infiltrator

Infiltrator includes tools to reduce enmity, evade attacks, and reposition behind a hostile target. Shadow Step does not grant invisibility.

Espionage - Saboteur

Saboteur places visible traps that arm after a delay and trigger damage or conditions when enemies reach them.
